name: CFAbench
description: CFAbench is a benchmark designed to evaluate forensic reasoning abilities of LLM agents in cybersecurity tasks such as incident response, evidence correlation, and threat attribution, using a controlled testbed generating forensic evidence from 20 curated incidents.
reputation: A niche cybersecurity benchmark from a controlled forensic testbed, mainly used in research on LLM-based incident analysis rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Uses a controlled testbed with vulnerable services and forensic evidence; focuses on recent vulnerabilities and progressive forensic checkpoints.
